subject: Contract questionnaire: IP / indemnity / liability cap — follow-up and suggested positions
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@zephyrai.com>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@zephyrai.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: contract questionnaire and order form items

Sergio — thanks for the demo last week. Attached is the legal questionnaire our procurement team flagged after an initial review (ZephyrAI_RFP_Contract_Questions.xlsx). We need clarification on a few high-priority items before we can proceed to internal procurement: 

1) IP ownership: do you require assignment of model weights or derivatives? Can you confirm Redwood's position on customer-created prompts and fine-tunes?
2) Indemnity: what scope of indemnity does Redwood offer for third-party claims arising from model outputs (e.g., alleged IP infringement or defamatory outputs)?
3) Liability cap & remedies: proposed monetary cap and carve-outs (bodily injury, gross negligence, wilful misconduct). Also any uptime or SLA credits that would apply in the event of platform disruption.
4) Order form: sample order form language around term, termination for convenience, and data deletion/return.

We'd appreciate a short matrix of your standard positions plus any optional concessions you can make for enterprise customers. Can you send back a redline-friendly PDF by EOD Monday PST? Procurement is aiming for signed order by end of month.

Thanks — happy to hop on a call if that's easier.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Procurement
ZephyrAI

Attachments: ZephyrAI_RFP_Contract_Questions.xlsx

From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Elena Park <elena.park@zephyrai.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 17 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: contract questionnaire and order form items

Elena — thanks, looping in Legal and Sales Ops. Attached is our draft answers packet (Redwood_RFP_Answers_20260117.pdf) and a short executive summary below. We kept the language redline-friendly so your counsel can mark up. Key positions: 

- IP: Redwood does not require assignment of Redwood model weights. Customer retains ownership over their Customer Data and any custom prompts or fine-tunes they supply to the extent permitted by underlying model licensing. Redwood grants customers a limited, perpetual (for the term of the subscription) license to use model outputs. We can add an optional addendum that clarifies ownership of customer-created fine-tunes when customers pay for dedicated checkpoints.

- Indemnity: Redwood offers indemnity for third-party claims alleging infringement of third-party intellectual property to the extent caused by Redwood's delivery of the licensed service and models (narrow IP indemnity). We are not able to indemnify for customer prompts or custom data that introduce third-party content; those remain the customer's responsibility.

- Liability cap & carve-outs: Standard cap = greater of (i) USD 1,000,000 or (ii) 12 months of fees paid under the applicable order form. Carve-outs: (a) willful misconduct and gross negligence; (b) indemnity obligations; (c) certain data protection liabilities as required by law. We are open to increasing the cap for strategic enterprise commitments (e.g., annual committed spend thresholds).

- SLA & credits: For Hosted API, we publish SLOs in the Console. For Dedicated / Private deployments we can negotiate explicit availability targets with financial credits (typical credit schedule in Order Form).

- Order form: We typically propose a one-year initial term with automatic renewals, termination for convenience with 90 days' notice and pro-rated refunds for pre-paid committed capacity. Data deletion: Redwood will delete customer data within 30 days of contract termination unless retention is expressly requested and paid for.

Please review the attached and let us know which items you'd like to discuss. If it helps, we can draft a short, tracked redline of your preferred clause edits. 

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_RFP_Answers_20260117.pdf

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: internal: suggested legal edits & risk highlights for Zephyr (do not forward)

Team — quick internal note after reviewing the draft answers and Zephyr's questionnaire. Attaching formal redlines (legal_redlines_zephyr.docx). High-level suggestions: 

- Narrow indemnity: tighten wording to make clear Redwood's indemnity requires (i) customer provide prompt notice of claim, (ii) customer cede control of defense to Redwood, and (iii) customer reasonably cooperate. Add explicit carve-out for outputs resulting from customer-provided training data/prompts.
- Liability cap: shift from "greater of $1M or 12 months fees" to "greater of $1M or 12 months fees paid in the prior 12 months" to avoid manipulation via prepayments; consider negotiation threshold where we accept $3M for >$2M ARR commitments.
- Data retention: reduce default deletion window to 15 days for hosted environments where feasible; keep 30 days for dedicated/on-prem due to backup procedures.
- Subprocessors & security: propose a limited notification + objection right rather than per-subprocessor sign-off; maintain SOC 2 documentation as evidence.

Risks to flag with Sales: Zephyr's customer data includes regulated healthcare PII in some pilots — recommend Private deployment discussion and KMS/HSM options. Also recommend sales pursue a short call with Zephyr legal to align on IP carve-outs rather than exchanging long redlines. 

I'll be available on Tue afternoon for a 30-min review.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: legal_redlines_zephyr.docx

From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Elena Park <elena.park@zephyrai.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, procurement@zephyrai.com
Date: Fri, 23 Jan 2026 15:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: contract questionnaire and order form items

Elena — thanks for the patience. Per the attached Order Form draft (Redwood_OrderForm_Draft_20260123.pdf) and our packet, here is a short summary of what Redwood can commit to today and where we ask for flexibility: 

1) IP: Redwood will not require assignment of model weights. Customer retains ownership of Customer Data and customer-created prompts/fine-tunes; Redwood grants a license to operate the model for the customer's internal business purposes. If Zephyr requires exclusive ownership of a custom fine-tune, we can discuss a commercial add-on and governance terms.

2) Indemnity: Redwood will provide a limited IP infringement indemnity for claims arising from our delivered models or software, subject to standard notice, cooperation, and defense-control provisions. We cannot provide indemnity for customer-provided content or prompts.

3) Liability cap: Our baseline cap is the greater of USD 1,000,000 or 12 months of fees paid. We are open to revising the cap for a committed volume agreement — propose a call to align on spend tiers if Zephyr wants a higher cap. Carve-outs remain for willful misconduct and statutory liabilities.

4) Order form & data: Draft Order Form reflects 12-month initial term, 90-day termination for convenience, and 30-day deletion for hosted products. For pilots involving regulated data (you mentioned healthcare), recommend the Private deployment option (we can include KMS/HSM and extended deletion schedules in that addendum).

Next steps: 
- Laura (legal) suggested a short live call to cover the indemnity and cap mechanics — we recommend 30 minutes this week. 
- If Zephyr's counsel prefers tracked changes, we can ingest their PDF redline and produce an approved redline within 48 hours. 

Proposed times (PST): Tue 1/27 10:00–10:30, Wed 1/28 14:00–14:30. Let me know what works and I will send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Sergio Alvarez
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_OrderForm_Draft_20260123.pdf
